item.aggregated_output:
---
title: "Taboot Par Naqi Ke Aaye Hain Karbala Wale"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Other"
poet: "Shahbaz"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Taboot Par Naqi Ke Aaye Hain Karbala Wale.
Mazloom Shah Naqi Ko Rotay Hain Khud Khuda Walay.
Zehar-e-Sitam Se Kata Mazloom Ke Jigar Ko.
Aaye Hain Dafan Karne Pardais Mein Kisa Walay.

2
Bag-e-Rasool Ke Hain Kuch Phool Bikhrey Aisay.
Na Ho Sakay Zamane Mein Yakja Yeh Mustafa Walay.
Aadam Se Le Ke Khatim Hain Sogowar Sare.
Pursa Naqi Ko Deney Aaye Hain Murtaza Walay.

3
Hai Pursa Iss Jahan Mein Sadaat Syeda Ka.
Hadi Jo Deen Ke Hain Shahbaz Fatima Walay.
Basilsila-e-Shahadat
Hazrat Imam Ali Naqi 3 Rajab

p = Path('src/data/lyrics/taboot-par-naqi-ke-aaye-hain-karbala-wale-tajpoints-84362e1f609c4884c582.md')
_, front, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
for section, numbers in [(roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')]:
    blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in section.strip().replace('\\n  ', '\\n').split('\\n\\n')]
    assert [block[0] for block in blocks[:3]] == list(numbers)
    assert [len(block)-1 for block in blocks[:3]] == [4, 4, 2]
    assert len(blocks) == 4 and len(blocks[3]) == 2
print('Both editions contain stanzas of 4, 4, and 2 verses and a two-line closing note.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu script in the selected lyric and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Both editions retain the three stanzas of 4, 4, and 2 verses. I kept the final two lines as a closing note.

I rendered “Kata” as `کٹا` and “Khatim” as `خاتم`. The file now uses right-to-left direction and the `noUrdu` tag is cleared.
